IC1: - ≥1 Primary Anterior Teeth [AND] with early carious lesion (Class V) of ICDAS scores 1-2.
IC2: - Subjects whose parents are willing and able to maintain good oral hygiene for their children [AND] and attend study visits.
IC3: - Subjects with Saliva of normal flow rates (30-60sec) [AND] and with healthy saliva pH 6.75-7.25.
IC5: - Subjects with a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 12 primary anterior teeth [AND] with early carious lesions Class V of ICDAS score 1-2.
